headline: Эксперты объяснили, почему лидер Китая лично встречал Дональда Трампа у самолета
summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping personally met US President Donald Trump at the aircraft steps on his arrival in China for a trilateral meeting. Experts have commented on the gesture.
why: US-China relations shape trade tariffs, technology controls and supply chains that matter for global equities and commodities. High-level meetings often signal the direction of trade talks.
